subject.title: fix: render workspace avatars in identity card

question: Should this PR be the canonical avatar-401 fix, and may it change unsupported workspace avatar sources to fallback instead of prior agents.list inlining behavior?
rationale: The code direction is a good owner-boundary fix, but the stricter projection policy and overlapping avatar PRs are compatibility and sequencing choices that automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Fix CI and land this branch
options.body: After the mechanical type/lint blockers are fixed, accept the image-only projection policy and close the overlapping avatar branch set around this solution.

options.title: Preserve list compatibility
options.body: Keep the identity/bootstrap route suppression but avoid changing existing agents.list projection behavior for previously accepted local avatar values.

options.title: Choose a narrower PR
options.body: Pause this branch and make one of the smaller overlapping avatar PRs the canonical landing path if maintainers want less policy surface.

recommendation.title: Fix CI and land this branch
recommendation.body: After the mechanical type/lint blockers are fixed, accept the image-only projection policy and close the overlapping avatar branch set around this solution.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Control UI/Gateway history and prior routing make this the best available owner for the compatibility and cluster decision.
